headline: Itaú BBA Upgrades Gerdau to Buy as Shares Surge
summary: Itaú BBA upgraded its recommendation for Gerdau to buy, citing stronger fundamentals and recent share price declines that created an attractive risk-return profile. Gerdau shares rose nearly 6%.
why: Analyst recommendation upgrades from major financial institutions often trigger short-term institutional buying and re-evaluations of corporate valuations.

impacts.name: Gerdau SA
impacts.why: An analyst upgrade to buy combined with positive risk-reward assessments stimulated buying pressure on the stock.

why_moved: The positive analyst revision from Itaú BBA altered market sentiment regarding Gerdau's valuation, driving up demand for its shares.
